new.n: Copper box of gold coins in a creek bank, 3 mi SW of Walnut Grove
new.pl: 'Three miles southwest of Walnut Grove' (GNIS Walnut Grove offset 3 miles SW); the farm is not yet placed on a plat.
new.st: A farmer digging along a small creek bank on his farm found a watertight copper box, smaller than a brick, holding twelve $20 and one $10 gold pieces ($250). Who buried it was never learned. One source so far. Pin: 'Three miles southwest of Walnut Grove' (GNIS Walnut Grove offset 3 miles SW); the farm is not yet placed on a plat.
new.t: Found, but whoever buried a copper box may have left more along the same creek bank. Find the farm and the creek on a c.1930 Redwood County plat and the 1938 aerial, then detect the bank with permission. Access: Private farmland: ask permission.
src: Sauk Centre Herald, 26 Jun 1930, p. 8, 'Excited Over Finding Gold', reprinted from the Tracy Headlight Herald (newspapers.com image 879918517, PC read)
